[Reaffirmed full-year guidance items.] We are executing well, delivering on our strategy, and remain on track to achieve our $7 billion free cash flow inflection by 2029.”

[Reaffirmed full-year guidance items.] Signed agreements to sell noncore Lower 48 assets for $1.7 billion, which closed in July, achieving $5 billion disposition target ahead of schedule.

[Reaffirmed full-year guidance items.] Signed an agreement to acquire a 42% interest in a joint venture in the Kirkuk area of northern Iraq, accessing long-life, conventional redevelopment opportunities at an attractive entry cost and competitive cost of supply; closing expected by year-end 2026.
[Reaffirmed full-year guidance items.] Advanced commercial LNG strategy with additional 2 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) of offtake agreements, bringing total LNG offtake to 12 MTPA.
[Reaffirmed full-year guidance items.] Ended the quarter with cash and short-term investments of $8.1 billion and long-term investments of $1.2 billion.

[Reaffirmed full-year guidance items.] ConocoPhillips declared a third-quarter ordinary dividend of $0.84 per share, payable Sept. 1, 2026, to stockholders of record at the close of business on Aug. 17, 2026.
[Reaffirmed full-year guidance items.] After adjusting for closed acquisitions and dispositions, second-quarter 2026 production decreased 98 MBOED or 4% from the same period a year ago.
[Reaffirmed full-year guidance items.] The company’s total average realized price was $62.33 per BOE, 36% higher than the $45.77 per BOE realized in the second quarter of 2025.
[Reaffirmed full-year guidance items.] For the quarter, cash provided by operating activities was $7.4 billion.
[Reaffirmed full-year guidance items.] Excluding a change in working capital, ConocoPhillips generated CFO of $7.2 billion.
[Reaffirmed full-year guidance items.] In addition, ConocoPhillips received $0.2 billion of disposition proceeds from the sale of noncore assets.
